notes.title: v1.2.0 - The Frog Goblin Easy Combat Mode
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

In this update, Yam, The Frog Goblin, hacked our systems to make combat easy.

If you want to enjoy the story and puzzles, without having to bother too much about combat, you can enable Yam's enhancements on her terminals (these are the ones with all the frog decoration).

Easy combat mode will give you 2 extra HP and stronger attack. The game is not impacted in any other way. You will still have access to the same achievements and puzzles, without the combat pressure.

Here are all the changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Enable easy combat mode in Yam's terminals. This gives 2 extra HP and stronger attack for people that enjoy puzzles but want an easier combat experience.
[*] The T Barrel gun is unlocked from the first merchant. This gun is fun to use and also helps with combat. Now you don't have to wait till late game to have access to it.
[*] Fixed a bug causing double input from some XBox series custom controllers, which was skipping dialogue lines.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the changes!

 Vini
